{'text': '《時代》雜誌剛剛公布咗2026年最佳發明榜單，iPhone Duo入選，John Ternus更加登上咗雜誌封面。以下係Ternus喺《時代》訪問中嘅分享。', 'paragraph_context': 'TIME has just published its list of the best inventions of 2026, and iPhone Duo made the list with John Ternus featured on the magazine cover. Here’s what Ternus said in his interview with TIME.'}

{'text': 'John Ternus談iPhone Duo嘅由來、延遲上市等話題', 'paragraph_context': 'John Ternus on iPhone Duo origins, delay to market, more'}

{'text': 'John Ternus坐低同《時代》進行咗一次範圍廣泛嘅訪問，圍繞iPhone Duo展開，亦都涵蓋咗人工智能等多個其他話題。', 'paragraph_context': 'John Ternus sat down with TIME for a wide-ranging interview centered on iPhone Duo, but also covering a variety of other topics, including AI.'}

{'text': '至於iPhone Duo，相比其他摺疊手機遲咗近十年先至上市，而Ternus早喺2011年就已經喺Apple參與摺疊屏幕嘅早期研發工作。', 'paragraph_context': 'Regarding the iPhone Duo, which is hitting the market nearly a decade after other foldables, Ternus was involved in early foldable work at Apple all the way back in 2011.'}

{'text': '2011年嘅時候，好多人仲用緊揭蓋式手機，Ternus同另外五位工程師就申請咗一項摺疊式電子設備嘅專利，探討呢個構思需要用到咩類型嘅電池同電路板。Ternus話：「好明顯，我哋最終一定會去到OLED顯示屏可以屈曲嘅階段。」', 'paragraph_context': 'In 2011, when many people still carried around flip phones, Ternus and five other engineers filed a patent application for foldable electronic devices, exploring what kind of batteries and circuit boards might be needed for such an idea. “It felt clear that we were going to eventually get to a place where OLED displays were going to be flexible,” Ternus says.'}

{'text': 'Ternus對2010年代其他公司嘅摺疊手機早期嘗試都唔太欣賞。佢話：「世界上其他嘅例子睇落都好似有啲廉價同劣質。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Ternus wasn’t a fan of early attempts at foldables from other companies in the 2010s. He says, “The other examples in the world felt kind of cheap and crappy.”'}

{'text': 'Apple產品設計副總裁Richard Dinh分享咗一個故事，足以體現佢哋決心造出一款同競爭對手唔同嘅摺疊裝置。', 'paragraph_context': 'The drive to achieve a foldable unlike its competitors is evidenced by a story from Richard Dinh, Apple’s VP of Product Design.'}

{'text': '過程中，Ternus鼓勵團隊投放更多時間同精力去呢個項目，儘管其他摺疊手機已經搶閘上市。Dinh話有一次佢問Ternus，佢哋嘅團隊應唔應該採用一種類似競爭對手嘅表面材料，雖然Dinh認為嗰種材料有缺陷，但係可能已經夠用。', 'paragraph_context': 'Along the way, Ternus encouraged the team to invest more time and effort in the project, even as other foldables beat them to market. Dinh says that at one point, he asked Ternus whether his team should proceed with a top surface material similar to those of its competitors, which Dinh felt had flaws but was potentially good enough.'}

{'text': '「佢就好似話：『睇住啦，Rich，你會知道幾時係啱嘅時機。』呢句說話畀咗我哋信心去突破創新同製造嘅界限，仲飛去世界各地將供應商串連起嚟，研發出nano-texture（一種表面技術）。」Dinh話。最終成果——一個由特製聚合物製成嘅表面，搭載喺一個內含超過100個微型精密組件嘅鉸鏈之上——已經打動首批用戶，佢哋話幾乎完全感覺唔到摺痕。', 'paragraph_context': '“And he was like, ‘Look, Rich, you’ll know when it’s the right thing.’ And that gave us the confidence to really push the boundaries on innovation and manufacturing, and fly worldwide to connect our suppliers together and come up with the nanotexture [a surface technology],” Dinh says. The result—a surface made from a custom polymer and built atop a hinge with more than 100 tiny interior precision components—has impressed its first users, who have said they can barely detect a crease at all.'}

{'text': '篇報導仲提到Ternus「喺擔任CEO嘅初期，將大部分時間都投放喺設計上，每星期花幾日留喺工作室，同工業設計同人機界面團隊一齊工作。」呢點同彭博之前關於Ternus早期工作重點嘅報道相呼應。', 'paragraph_context': 'The story also mentions that Ternus “has devoted much of his early tenure as CEO to obsessing over design, spending multiple days a week in the studio with the industrial-design and human-interface teams.” This echoes previous Bloomberg reporting around Ternus’s early priorities.'}

{'text': 'Ternus喺訪問中提及嘅其他話題包括：', 'paragraph_context': 'Other topics Ternus addresses in the interview include:'}

  • {'text': 'Apple Intelligence對Gemini技術嘅依賴：「我哋嘅目標唔係要自己包辦產品入面嘅每一樣嘢。我哋只係喺能夠真正帶嚟差異化嘅地方落手。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Intelligence’s reliance on Gemini technology: “There’s not really a goal that we have to make every single thing in a product. We make the things where we can really bring differentiation.”'}
  • {'text': 'Siri AI嘅獨特優勢：「你嘅日常生活一切都喺部電話入面。透過Siri AI，你可以運用晒所有呢啲資訊去完成任務、學習新知、解決問題，做到其他人做唔到嘅嘢。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Siri AI’s unique advantages: “Everything in your life is on your phone. With Siri AI, you can leverage all that information to do things, learn things, and figure out things in a way that nobody else can do.”'}
  • {'text': '9月活動前瞓得少：「嗰陣我全靠腎上腺素、咖啡因同埋對當日嘅興奮撐住。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Not sleeping much before September event: “I was on such a moment of adrenaline and caffeine and excitement for the day.”'}

{'text': '《時代》嘅全文非常值得一讀，可以喺呢度睇到。', 'paragraph_context': 'The full TIME article is well worth a read, available here.'}
